title: •Wookiee Roar
caption: •Wookiee Roar (V)
game_text: If a battle was just initiated involving a Wookiee, add one destiny to your total power (two if alone). That Wookiee is defense value +3 for remainder of turn. OR If you have 8 or more cards in hand, cancel a Force drain.
